quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog (orders for products scheduled to ship within the following 12 months, subject to Vicor's scheduling and cancellation policies) was approximately $176,938,000 at December 31, 2025, versus $155,505,000 at December 31, 2024. Backlog remained approximately flat during 2025, with a book-to-bill ratio of approximately 1.0 for the year and an improvement in the fourth quarter; average quarterly turns volume was approximately 34% of 2025 total net revenues.

Vicor manufactures Brick and Advanced Products in its approximately 320,000 square foot Andover, Massachusetts facility, except certain Advanced Products manufactured, packaged and tested by third-party wafer foundries and packaging contractors (not named) in the United States and Asia. As part of expanding Andover capacity for Advanced Products it brought in-house the complex electroplating operation previously outsourced, and work is underway to bring in-house an additional final power-module manufacturing step now performed by a subcontractor. 2025 capital expenditures were $20,318,000 (vs $23,602,000 in 2024), with approximately $3,877,000 of capital expenditure commitments at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 capex $20,318,000; capex commitments ~$3,877,000 (December 31, 2025); Andover facility ~320,000 sq ft
